avis.texte: I’ll be honest — I usually gravitate toward Korean sunscreens. Over the years, I’ve found they often have lighter textures, feel more user-friendly, and make daily SPF much easier to commit to. Many traditional sunscreens can feel heavy, greasy, chalky, or like a layer you can’t wait to wash off. Because of that, Korean formulas have often been my preference. So this product genuinely surprised me. At 52, post-menopausal, with dry skin that can also become sensitive, sunscreen has to do more than just protect. If it feels unpleasant, drying, or heavy, I simply won’t enjoy using it consistently. This one absolutely delivers where it matters. The first thing I noticed was how light and comfortable the texture feels. It spreads easily, absorbs quickly, and sits beautifully on the skin without that thick sunscreen feeling many people dislike. It truly feels more like a skincare product than a traditional SPF. That is high praise coming from someone who usually reaches for Korean sunscreens. What impressed me most is that this formula feels right on par with many of the smoother Korean sunscreens I’ve used. It has that modern, easy-to-wear feel that makes daily use simple and pleasant. My skin feels hydrated and comfortable rather than coated. I also appreciate that it leaves an invisible finish on my skin. No heavy residue, no obvious cast, and no greasy shine. It gives a healthy finish that works well on its own or under makeup. Another major plus is the ingredient profile. The

I really like this sunscreen and would highly recommend it. It feels lightweight, smooth, and comfortable on my skin. It doesn’t feel heavy or greasy, and it works well for daily sun protection. I also like the packaging and the quality of the product. Overall, I’m very happy with my purchase and would buy it again.

avis.titre: Very good sunscreen, but slightly greasy
avis.texte: This is a very good sunscreen and I like how it feels on my skin. It applies easily and provides good protection. The only downside is that it leaves my face looking and feeling a little greasy. Overall, I’m happy with the product and would still recommend it, especially for someone who doesn’t mind a dewy finish.

This formula is dreamy. Weightless, not sticky and very moisturizing. It sinks into the skin effortlessly. Most unique sunscreen I’ve ever used. I can wear this daily even if I’m not leaving the house - it just feels like luxury skincare.

avis.titre: Great Sunscreen for a Mindful Budget
avis.texte: I really like this sunscreen! I use a lot of sunscreen in the summer and try to use a moderately priced product during these months. I like this brand and trust it more than most. I have found a new summer sunscreen for my face! It’s not greasy, blends in quickly without any residue. Goes under my foundation beautifully.
Worth every single penny! It definitely doesn’t feel like sunscreen once you put it on it’s like if you have nothing on the skin!!
Great facial sunscreen! Does not feel greasy and you only need a small amount to cover the face.

avis.titre: Lightweight sunscreen that feels amazing on the skin
avis.texte: I’ve tried many sunscreens and this one quickly became one of my favorites. It feels super lightweight, absorbs fast, and doesn’t leave a white cast or greasy feeling. My skin looks hydrated and smooth after applying it, and it works really well under makeup. Perfect for everyday use, especially in Florida weather. ☀️

avis.titre: The Product I Can’t Live Without!
avis.texte: I’m delighted with this product. It has become my favorite. It helps protect me from the sun, I apply it before my makeup, and my skin has become more hydrated.

avis.titre: Hydrating and lightweight, with a little shine
avis.texte: I recently started using this serum and so far I like it. The texture is really lightweight and I like that this is different from other sunscreens I have use, as it doesn’t feel super heavy on my skin. It absorbs fairly quickly and I can wear it under my makeup without any issues. I have noticed that my skin feels softer since using it, which is an added bonus. The only downside for me is that I feel like it leaves a bit of a shine to my face. It’s not a deal breaker for me, as I like everything else about it, but if you have oily skin you might want to consider that. Overall, I would still recommend this because it’s hydrating and has a high spf.

I live in South Florida and I am outdoors every day. This is the sunscreen that I use on my face every day. The small container, less than 2.5" x 3.5", easily fits in my pocket, making it super convenient to carry with me. It's easy to dispense and apply, or reapply, has no scent, and does not feel oily or sticky at all. It really feels like nothing at all. Best of all: It's effective! My dermatologist highly approves.

avis.titre: Super lightweight and very smooth high quality sunscreen
avis.texte: I'll be honest, I rarely use high end sunscreen. I buy a lot of other products for my skincare and sunscreen is either a component of one of those, or it's an afterthought. But I couldn't resist trying this and I am very glad I did. I am pretty active and love being outdoors, but technically a senior citizen :-). I'm lucky that my face looks a lot younger than my age and I want to keep it that way, so a good sunscreen is a necessity. I use toner, serum and moisturizers, under minimal makeup, and needed a sunscreen that isn't heavy or leaves a white residue and that will work with my other products. This works perfectly for that. It is light, goes on easily and smooth and has a very nice texture. I used it over my moisturizer and under my powder foundation and worked well. I am heading to Antartica next month and with the bright sun, I'll need good protection for my face and SPF 50 is perfect. This container is relatively small so will work well for travel. A little of this lotion goes a long way. Overall, I think this is a high quality product well worth the price.

This sunscreen serum is a lifesaver for maturing skin! You get the benefits of a serum but also protection from harmful UV rays. The formula is lightweight and non-greasy. It does not leave a white cast as most sunscreens do.

avis.titre: Great for those with sensitive skin conditions
avis.texte: As someone with rosacea and highly sensitive to facial products I do extensive research on all products before applying to my face. I have a trip coming up and will need a good sunscreen to take with me. This sunscreen is highly rated by dermatologists for mature skin so I wanted to give this a try. This is much more than I typically spend but I wanted a "good" product to apply to my face to protect it. This is a nice lightweight sunscreen and soaks in well with no visible residue afterwards. This caused absolutely no irritation at all to my areas where I have rosacea. I even went back and reapplied it 3 hrs later to verify there would be no issues and it was fine. Based on the cost, I would keep this just for the face as I am fine applying cheaper products on my body. But for my face, this will be my new sunscreen product to keep on hand and that will be going with me on my vacation.

LRP products are touted for sensitive skin. This is the second LRP product I’ve had to return because it has badly inflamed my skin. I had bought 2 and am returning only the one I hadn’t opened, but they are not giving me a choice to return through Whole Foods. Instead I have to take it to UPS, which is punitive.

This sunscreen is different from any other sunscreen I've ever used - and better! Most sunscreen I've used had a chalky quality to them that ultimately became very drying. I'm someone who has very dry, sensitive skin which can easily be irritated. I used this La Roche posay serum sunscreen and it never caused any irritation or reaction on my skin. It's light. It's moisturizing. It fades right into your skin so you do not have that white cast that many sunscreens can leave on your face. Importantly for someone like myself who has issues with fragrances, this is a completely fragrance-free product. I'm giving four stars instead of five, because the size of the bottle is so small that it will only last a month if you use it everyday.

The La Roche Posay UV Air Sunscreen Serum has spf 50 along with niacinamide and hyaluronic acid. This broad spectrum sunscreen is meant just for the face. It has 4 different types of sunscreen listed and says to apply every two hours. I applied it just to see if I could wear it. I normally never use any sunscreen unless it's meant for babies and is zinc based. Sunscreen normally super irritates my skin. But wearing heavy baby zinc based sunscreen on my face isn't a nice feel. This sunscreen didn't give me any irritation, no redness, no rash. It really must be gentle. I reapplied it after 4 hours and still no reaction to it. It has no noticeable scent. It comes out as a white thin cream, and after rubbing it in, it is completely invisible. After just a couple of minutes there was no noticeable feel of it on my skin. My skin felt soft and hydrated with no heavy product feel. This is an incredible face sunscreen. I think this is an exceptional value and an outstanding product. I am super happy to find a sunscreen I can actually wear.

avis.titre: Excellent quality, lightweight sunscreen for sensitive skin!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is amazing and easily one of the best I’ve tried. The texture truly lives up to the “air” name—it’s lightweight, fast-absorbing, and very comfortable to wear throughout the day. It layers well under makeup and doesn’t feel greasy or heavy on the skin. There’s no obnoxious white cast, which is a huge plus, and I love that it contains niacinamide and hyaluronic acid for added skin-care benefits. It feels hydrating without clogging pores, and the classic sunscreen scent is present but not overpowering. I have sensitive, acne and eczema-prone skin, and this caused zero irritation or breakouts, which is rare for me when it comes to SPF. My skin actually feels calm and comfortable while wearing it. Overall, this is an excellent quality sunscreen, and I genuinely prefer it over EltaMD. If you’re looking for a high-performance SPF that feels more like skincare than sunscreen, this one is absolutely worth trying.

avis.titre: Great Compact Sunscreen On the Go
avis.texte: I love La Roche-Posay products. They are a bit pricey, but worth the cost. This sunscreen is another great hit. It goes on smoothly without pilling. It leaves a glow on my skin. I have oily skin to begin with and I don’t see a difference in more oiliness. It definitely doesn’t help with that. It has a light scent that is standard sunscreen scent. It doesn’t leave a white cast on my skin. I have an olive-tan complexion. The bottle is small, very compact with a lid to prevent the product from leaking. Perfect for taking on the go. As with all sunscreens, it does say to reapply every two hours.

La Roche-Posay is deeply rooted in dermatological science and research to create innovative skin care products that are recommended by dermatologists around the world. This SPF 50 sunscreen is not like any other that I’ve used. While it blocks out UVA and UVB rays, it’s milky lightweight and does not leave a greasy feeling on my skin. The addition of niacinamide and hyaluronic acid is genius as it adds hydration to my skin. Because of its light texture, it works great as my first layer before applying makeup. During the summer when I’m outdoors more, this will be easy to take on the go and apply every 2 hours. This is a 1.7 ounce bottle with small tip applicator for precise product release to avoid waste. It’s the perfect size container to toss in my bag. This is serious sunscreen to protect skin from harmful UVA and UVB rays while also providing skin care level hydration. I use this daily on my face, neck and hands and will be recommending to family and friends!

avis.titre: FINALLY! A lightweight Sunscreen for sensitive skin WITHOUT the smell!
avis.texte: This stuff is AMAZING! I cannot believe just how lightweight and clear the end product is. It's invisible. Completely My skin is very sensitive and acne prone, even at the age of 36. This is literally THE FIRST sunscreen I have ever worn that has not caused break-outs! Considering I am now using a Retinol product, I needed to find a sunscreen to protect my skin. This is perfect. Beyond perfect. It has protected my skin well from the sun down here in Georgia. The product also sits well on top of my moisturizer, and below my foundation. You would never know it is there. There is a very subtle sunscreen smell, but it is not over-powering like others I have used. 10/10 can recommend!

avis.titre: Super tiny bottle, but a tiny bit is all you need for each application
avis.texte: First off, I love La Roche Posay, my dermatologist recommends their mineral daily sunscreen, so I was excited to try this. A bit disappointed that the product wasn’t sealed at all when I got it. Very small bottle for ~$40 as of today. I’ve been trying out new serums a lot lately. This goes on more like runny sunscreen than serum, in my opinion. Smells a bit stronger than I expected, smells strongly like sunscreen. No white cast or residue. Love that it has a 50 spf rating, my fair skin needs all the sun protection it can get.

With 4 different kinds of sunscreen and totally awesome ingredient for my skin, you can’t lose with this La Roche-Posay UV Air Sunscreen Serum. First of all, this is one of my favorite brands. It’s pricey but well worth it. I feel really good about this serum and it will be a staple in my face care arsenal, especially this summer. It’s a pretty good size bottle for $39.99, so I’m happy about that. I haven’t used it long enough to speak on the results but I will say, so far, so good. It’s worth a try for sure.

This sunscreen completely changed my expectations for daily SPF. The serum-like texture is incredibly lightweight and truly feels like skincare rather than sunscreen. It spreads effortlessly, absorbs quickly, and leaves absolutely no white cast, even after applying the recommended amount. It layers beautifully under makeup, feels hydrating without being greasy, and gives my skin a healthy, natural glow. I love that it feels weightless on the skin while still providing strong SPF 50 protection. Perfect for everyday use, especially if you dislike heavy or sticky sunscreens. This has easily become a staple in my morning routine. There is also fragrance-free!
